newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Speculation builds in Grace calls.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Speculation builds in Grace calls.

text.p: Call options on W.R. Grace & Co continued to draw solid interest Wednesday as the stock posted a strong rally in the face of a broadly weak market.
Grace shares gained 1-3/16 to 66-1/2 after reaching a new 52-week high of 66-7/8. Turnover was about 734,000 shares.
Speculation continued to drive interest in the calls and push implied volatilities higher, traders said.
"They've taken volatility over the last several weeks from the mid-20's up to the low 60's," said Andrew Schwarz, senior partner at AGS Specialist Parnters.
Schwarz said the volatility has been pumped up on call buying, mostly from retail investors.
"There's a lot of speculation in the calls," he said.

Lawrence McMillan, president of McMillan Analysis Corp and publisher of the Daily Volume Alert, said in a report that volume in Grace options Tuesday was 1,470. Of that, 1,250 was on the call side. He said average daily volume was 380.
On Wednesday, about 1,800 Grace calls traded compared with just 58 puts.
Trading was led by the September 70 calls, which traded 530 contracts. The option, which had no open interest, added 1-5/16 to 3-7/8.
The September 65 call, which had the highest open interest of any Grace call with 1,567 contracts open, traded more than 200 contracts. It rose 3/4 to 5-1/2.
In his report, McMillan called the Grace September options "way too expensive to buy."
